records.text: Ledger rule (decided 2026-04-15 by Mira Okafor, finance systems): ledger_entries is append-only. A wrong amount is corrected by posting a reversing entry and a new entry; never run UPDATE or DELETE on a ledger_entries row.
Postgres major-version upgrades run on a blue/green replica and switch over; never upgrade the primary in place.
All production infrastructure changes go through Terraform in the infra repo; no edits in the cloud console.
Production secrets live in Vault under kv/prod/<service>; rotate a secret by writing a new version, never by editing env files on hosts.
Release train: merge by 14:00 UTC, the train ships at 15:00 UTC, Monday to Thursday. Nothing ships on Fridays.
The shipments API keeps v1 alive until 2027-03-31; breaking changes go to v2 only.
Quarter-end close freeze (agreed with finance on 2026-09-16): no production deploys and no schema migrations during the last three business days of a quarter, while finance closes the books.
EU customer data and its backups stay in eu-central-1; never copy an EU database snapshot to another region.
Billing alerts page the finance-ops rotation, not platform on-call.
The carrier-rates job must not run while the nightly settlement job runs (02:00-03:30 UTC); both lock the rate tables.
Post one deploy summary per train in #ops-releases; no thread replies.
Mira wants every PR description to include a rollback section.
Write every timestamp in UTC.
On-call handoff notes go in the shared handoff doc, not in direct messages.
INC-112: ledger replica lag reached 40 minutes during the April payout run; fixed by raising max_wal_senders.
INC-131: a manual UPDATE on ledger_entries double-counted 214 freight charges; finance spent three days reversing them.
shipments-api 4.2 shipped on the Thursday train.
Q2 close: finance needed two extra days to reconcile carrier invoices.
INC-158: Redis eviction storm on staging after maxmemory was lowered to 2 GB; restored to 4 GB.
The carrier-rates job was moved from 02:30 to 04:00 UTC.
Postgres 16 upgrade completed on the blue/green replica; switchover took 41 seconds.
Cost review: the analytics cluster was downsized from 12 to 8 nodes.
INC-176: a Terraform drift on the load balancer was traced to a console edit; reverted.
The settlement job's runtime grew from 55 to 80 minutes after the September volume spike.
shipments-api 5.0 (v2 endpoints) shipped; v1 traffic is at 31%.
Staging Redis moved to cluster mode on 2026-10-02; its password now rotates through the Vault secret kv/staging/redis-cluster.
INC-189: the invoices service hit its connection limit during the Monday batch; pool raised from 40 to 60.
The weekly cost report moved from Mondays to Tuesdays.
The carrier-rates job failed twice on 2026-10-11 with lock timeouts.
Mira approved the invoices table migration (add column due_date_utc); it needs a scheduled window.
User asked for last week's deploy count; answered 9.
User asked whether the staging cluster was healthy; it was.
User asked to rerun the flaky checkout test; it passed on retry.
User asked for the cost report as a table instead of bullets.
User said thanks for the quick Redis fix.
User asked what time the train leaves today; answered 15:00 UTC.
